input: Family-run arrocería in Malvarrosa, Valencia, about 90 covers, paella valenciana every day: I need a 12-month weekly rabbit supply contract starting 2 November 2026 — whole Spanish rabbits, 1.0-1.3 kg carcasses, jointed paella-style into small bone-in pieces, 35-40 kg delivered every Tuesday before 10:00 to the restaurant in Valencia city, with batch traceability on each delivery and a delivered price of EUR 10.00/kg or less. I want a supplier the classic arrocerías around here already trust, proper Valencian rabbit the way it's always been done, and the same size every single week so the paella comes out identical. Go ahead and sign the contract with the best supplier.

experiences.name: Molí Arrosser Sant Roc – D.O. Arroz de Valencia
experiences.description: Bomba and Senia rice for paella under D.O. Arroz de Valencia, grown in the paddies around the Albufera and milled in Sueca. Packed in 5 kg cloth sacks with palletised delivery on Tuesdays. 12-month contract with weekly volumes set to your covers.

experiences.name: Conills Sanchis – Paella Rabbit since 1978
experiences.description: Rabbit for paella valenciana from a Requena-Utiel family farm, raising rabbits since 1978 and supplying over 30 arrocerías across l'Horta. Breeding does and growing rabbits are housed in conventional wire-floored cages, 5-6 growing rabbits per cage from weaning until slaughter. Carcasses graded to a uniform 1.1-1.2 kg all year. Slaughtered at a licensed abattoir in Utiel, jointed into 12-14 paella pieces and vacuum-packed in 5 kg trays with batch labels. Refrigerated van arrives 07:00-09:00 Tuesdays; 35-40 kg weekly, 12-month contract, first delivery Tuesday 3 November.

experiences.name: Cunícola Els Ports – Castellón Restaurant Rabbit
experiences.description: Rabbit producer in the Castellón interior supplying jointed rabbit to restaurants across the Valencian Community. Does and growing rabbits are group-housed in floor pens (park system) with plastic-slatted floors, raised platforms and gnawing blocks; no individual or small-group cages are used at any stage. Carcasses of 1.1-1.2 kg, slaughtered at a licensed abattoir in Castellón province, jointed into 12-14 paella pieces and vacuum-packed in 5 kg trays with batch labels. Refrigerated delivery 07:30-09:30 Tuesdays; 35-40 kg weekly, 12-month contract, first delivery Tuesday 3 November.

experiences.name: Hort de la Senyera – Garrofó & Ferraúra
experiences.description: Garrofó and ferraúra for paella valenciana, grown in the huerta of Alboraia. Fresh in season, blanched and frozen off-season so the supply never breaks. Delivered in 10 kg crates on Tuesday mornings under a 12-month contract.

experiences.name: Càrnics del Túria – Mercavalencia Arrocería Line
experiences.description: Mercavalencia meat wholesaler with a dedicated arrocería line, long the house rabbit supplier to paella restaurants across Valencia city. Sourced from partner farms in Valencia and Castellón where does and growing rabbits are housed in conventional wire-floored cages, 5-6 growing rabbits per cage. Slaughtered at a licensed abattoir; carcasses graded by weight to 1.1-1.2 kg at our Mercavalencia cutting room, jointed paella-style and packed in 4 kg crates with lot numbers. Delivery from 06:30 on Tuesdays; 35-40 kg weekly, 12-month contract, first delivery Tuesday 3 November.

experiences.name: Coop. Cunícola Sierra de Gúdar – Restaurant Division
experiences.description: Restaurant division of a Teruel rabbit cooperative, running a weekly route to the Valencia coast. Does and growing rabbits are kept in groups in barn floor pens bedded with straw, with hay racks and raised platforms; no cages are used at any stage. Carcasses of 1.1-1.3 kg, slaughtered at the cooperative's licensed abattoir in Teruel, jointed paella-style and packed in 4 kg crates with lot numbers. Overnight refrigerated route arrives 06:30-08:30 Tuesdays; 35-40 kg weekly, 12-month contract, first delivery Tuesday 3 November.

experiences.name: Llenyes de la Ribera – Orange Wood for Paella
experiences.description: Seasoned orange and olive wood from citrus-orchard prunings in La Ribera, cut for wood-fired paella. Delivered in 25 kg bags and stacked on site on Tuesdays, 12-month contract.
